headline: AI研究員辭職示警
context: 一名任職於 Anthropic 的研究員本週辭職，在 X 上發文警告，公司正「一路衝向具備自我改進能力的超級智慧，拿所有人的性命做賭注」。

sources.name: TechCrunch
sources.summary: An Anthropic researcher resigned this week, warning in a post on X that the company is “racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives”. The company’s own alignment lead even co-signed the message rather than walking it back. It’s the kind of doomer warning the AI industry has flirted with before, but the timing, with Anthropic reportedly preparing for an IPO, makes it land differently. On […]
sources.title: An Anthropic researcher’s doomsday warning comes at a very interesting time

thread_text:
AI研究員辭職示警

一名任職於Anthropic的研究員本週辭職，在X上發文警告，公司正「一路衝向具備自我改進能力的超級智慧，拿所有人的性命做賭注」。

這則警告，出現的時間點格外耐人尋味。

—— 本則來自 TechCrunch，2026 年 9 月 13 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
